QuestInfo.name: [Battle Mode] Training Interrupted
QuestInfo.0: The Battle Square was destroyed by the Black Mage's attack! Is Haktorius okay?
QuestInfo.1: The Black Mage's attack destroyed the Battle Square and put the Elite Soldier selection contest on hold. Keep training for now and be patient.

0.0: I'm glad to see you made it out with all your organs in the right places. Nobody saw that attack coming... \r\nI'm afraid official training's off the table for a while, but keep up with your exercises.\r\nWe're going to need all the help we can get when the real fighting starts.
